Changes for Welder: utils/util.py is _vda_util.py (imported relatively); the streaming
module (video_depth_stream.py) is left out; empty __init__.py files added;
dpt_temporal.py falls back to a plain dict when easydict is not installed.

The model weights are separate downloads with their own licences:
